joseph.title: File:Joseph receiving Pharaoh's Ring (2018 photo).jpg
joseph.description:
Joseph receives the Pharaoh's ring.
The photograph was taken in 2018 after completion of a restoration project started in 2016.

X-ray photography has shown that the black slave kneeling in the foreground was originally painted holding a tray, and that the background had an additional pillar indicating this was painted as an internal room before being redone as an open location.
joseph.note: Historical art illustrates the story. It does not establish actual appearance.
